reviewer_notes_from_code: AlertsWidget.jsx: every row's button is the bare word 'Acknowledge' - with 2+ alerts a screen-reader user hears identical buttons; needs per-alert accessible name.

AlertsWidget.jsx: acknowledging replaces the <button> with a <span>, so keyboard focus falls to <body>; the row also re-sorts to the bottom. Needs focus management (move focus to the row/next control) and an announcement of the state change.
AlertsWidget.jsx: <ul> with list-style:none loses list semantics in WebKit; add role=list.
Contrast of acknowledged chip (#6b7280 on #f9fafb ~4.6:1) and muted text passes AA at 12px/600 - borderline, not a defect.
Severity uses glyph + label + tint (colour-not-only already satisfied); focus ring token exists (:focus-visible 2px).
